name: tpl-existence-3-goal
task: Get into the locked room. Pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(target_room_entered) is redundant: with the hard Existence(target_picked_up) and the hard Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up), every accepted run already forces the room to be entered first. Remove Existence(target_room_entered); keep the Existence(target_picked_up) and the Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) requires the pickup and Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up) puts entering the room before it, which together force both events in the task's stated order.

texts: Pick up the mission's ball, after entering the target room.
